_comment: Seed list of company Ashby org slugs for the ashby source. The slug is the segment in a board URL: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug> (or api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<slug>). Add any company whose careers page is on Ashby. Override with ASHBY_COMPANIES="org1,org2" or a data/ashby-companies.json file. Unknown slugs 404 (or return no jobs) and are skipped.
